title: Do you have a dream apartment that you always go to?
content: I’ll have dreams where I’m at where I know is my home or current home- but then suddenly I get this realization out of nowhere that I have this other apartment that I just forget or forgot about. This apartment is in a fucked up part of town- definitely isn’t the safest area and I’be experienced some crazy shit just going to visit this place. The only way I can describe this part of town is it’s almost like everything is in a blue hue or filter. Everything’s dirty. In these dream places the kitchens are always filthy. Dunno why I go here or why it’s always a theme.
